title: Client Lifecycle Profile
description: Declarative join/leave (and eventually move) definition for a single client. One file per client. The runbook becomes data; the per-system logic lives in shared modules; the orchestrator selects the lane via -Action. Per-client variation (groups, OUs, attributes, licenses) is expressed as config — never as module code.
$comment: Token templating: string values in attributes, ou paths, homeDrive.unc, and group names may contain {tokens} resolved at PLAN time against the case context. Known tokens: {first} {last} {firstInitial} {username} {upn} {domain} {title} {department} {employmentType} {startDate} {extension} {role.name} {location.name} {location.timezone} {country.short} {country.name} {country.code}. The legacy <username> form is accepted as an alias for {username}. Conditions (see $defs/condition) use the same context and are resolved by the planner; only conditions on live system state (seat counts, mailbox size) stay in the modules.

schemaVersion.description: 2.1 adds top-level personas/globals and the unified condition grammar. 2.0 profiles remain valid (the new blocks are optional).

domains.description: All routable domains, e.g. uovo.com / uovo.fashion / uovo.art.

identity.description: Where the user truly lives. This one field drives most downstream behavior.

backbone.description: entra = cloud-only M365 is source of truth (Raith, BridgeInvest). google = Google Workspace primary, M365 mirrors it (Drive, Human Capital). ad-synced = on-prem AD syncs up to Entra via AD Connect (Six One, UOVO). ad-standalone = on-prem AD plus a SEPARATE, unsynced M365/Entra, both managed independently (Regal).

usernamePatterns.description: Ordered; each tried until a unique one is found. Tokens: {first} {last} {firstInitial} {domain}.

domainRules.description: Optional conditional domain/OU routing, e.g. uovo.fashion -> GardeRobe OU; Prialto users -> Prialto OU.

mode.description: generate = unique per user; shared-default = a standing 'Default New User Password' pulled from a secret (Human Capital, UOVO).

onOffboard.description: reset-and-capture = reset then deliver the new password to the manager/delegate via secure email.

globals.description: Config fragments applied to EVERY user, keyed by system key (e.g. 'active-directory', 'm365'). The planner deep-merges these UNDER persona and system config, resolving any conditional entries at plan time. Replaces the old script's $global_groups. Optional.

personas.description: Reusable role/persona bundles (replaces the old script's $roles table). Selected by intake (roles[]/title) or auto-selected via 'match'. Each persona contributes config fragments per system, layered between globals and the system's own config. Optional; cloud-only clients omit it.

condition.description: Boolean expression resolved at PLAN time against the case context (intake + selected persona + location + requested options). Grammar: <term> [(&& | ||) <term>]*, each term '<var> <op> <value>'. Vars are dotted paths: role.name, location.name, country.short, title, employmentType, plus intake booleans (avd, perimeter, ...). Operators: == != ~= (regex match) and 'in [a, b, c]'. Values may be quoted or bare; true/false are booleans. Examples: 'avd == true', 'location.name == CA', 'title ~= ^Remote Support', 'country.short == US && employmentType == Full-Time', 'title in [Project Manager, Project Engineer]'. An empty/absent condition means always-true. Conditions that need LIVE system state (seat counts, mailbox size) are NOT expressed here — the module owns those.

groupList.description: Security/distribution groups. Each item is either a plain group name (string, may contain {tokens}) or a conditional bundle { groups, when } added only when the condition resolves true. Supersedes the separate 'conditionalGroups' key (still accepted for back-compat).

attributeMap.description: Directory attribute name -> value, applied generically (the module loops and sets each; new attributes need NO module change). Values are {token} templates. Use the exact directory attribute name (e.g. title, department, company, extensionAttribute4, ipPhone, c, co, countryCode, employeeType). A value may also be a conditional list resolved to the first matching entry.

oneOf.description: Conditional value: first entry whose 'when' resolves true wins.

ouSpec.description: An OU as a single DN/name (string, may contain {tokens}) OR an array of { path, when } resolved to the first matching path at plan time.

configFragment.description: Partial system config contributed by globals or a persona, deep-merged by the planner under the system's own config. May carry conditional group/OU/attribute entries resolved at plan time. Open-ended so it can carry any key the target system's config supports.

titles.description: Selectable job titles for this persona (intake picks one; 'Other' allows free text).

match.description: Optional: auto-select this persona when the condition resolves true, instead of explicit intake selection.

systems.description: system key -> config fragment this persona contributes (e.g. active-directory: { ou, groups, attributes }, m365: { licenses }).

when.description: always = every run; on-request = only if a case variable asks for it; never = system absent for this lifecycle action.

lane.description: Per-action behavior for one system. Omit the lane to mean 'never' for that action.

dependsOn.description: Lane-specific ordering. Overrides the system-level dependsOn for this action (e.g. Spanning runs last on offboard, after mailbox conversion and license removal).

requiresApproval.description: Hard gate — e.g. no device wipe / no account delete without written POC approval.

captureEvidence.description: Screenshot membership/app access and attach to the case before changing it. Common on offboard.

schedule.description: Defer this step instead of running it now (e.g. archive after 30-90 days).

guardrails.description: Destructive-action protections that vary by client and are catastrophic to get wrong.

config.description: System- and action-specific settings: license bundles, group lists, OU paths, mailbox thresholds, data-transfer targets, etc. Known keys for active-directory and m365 are validated (see adOnboardConfig/m365OnboardConfig); other systems stay open-ended.

adOnboardConfig.description: active-directory onboard config. Known keys validated; extras allowed.

conditionalGroups.description: Legacy form (now also expressible inline in 'groups'). Each entry adds its groups when 'when' resolves true.

adOffboardConfig.description: active-directory offboard config. Known keys validated; extras allowed.

m365OnboardConfig.description: m365 onboard config. Known keys validated; extras allowed.

seatAwareLicenses.description: Run-time license fallback resolved by the module against LIVE seat counts: try each in order, assign the first with an available seat (via group membership or a direct SKU). Replaces the script's E5-else-E3 logic.

m365OffboardConfig.description: m365 offboard config. Known keys validated; extras allowed.

removeLicense.description: true = remove all licenses; object = conditional (e.g. { exceptWhen: 'mailbox above 50GB' }). The module honors the mailbox-size threshold either way.

key.description: Selects the module/handler. Known: servicenow, active-directory, directory-sync, m365, entra, exchange, google-workspace, mimecast, adobe, zoom, slack, 1password, spanning, perimeter81, tableau, notion, printix, egnyte, avd, workstation, welcome-letter, first-day-call, hardware, data-transfer, archive, equipment-return, case-resolution.

secrets.description: One or more keys into the top-level secrets map (1Password needs login + security key).
